description: Under the 1985 Settlement Agreement as amended in 2014, John Wayne Airport may serve up to 12.2 million annual passengers from January 1, 2026 through December 31, 2030, or 12.5 million if 11.21 million passengers were served in 2021-2025 and specified mitigation measures are met. The limit was 11.8 million annual passengers through December 31, 2025.
source_title: John Wayne Airport: Key Provisions of Settlement Agreement

description: The amended Settlement Agreement limits passenger service at John Wayne Airport to a maximum of 95 Class A average daily departures (a noise-based class; one average daily departure equals 365 departures a year) through December 31, 2030. A further 4 Class A average daily departures are designated for priority allocation to all-cargo service, and two of them may be allocated to passenger service.
source_title: John Wayne Airport: Key Provisions of Settlement Agreement

description: Orange County's General Aviation Noise Ordinance prohibits regularly scheduled commercial departures at John Wayne Airport between 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. (8:00 a.m. on Sundays) and arrivals between 11:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. (8:00 a.m. on Sundays). Airlines may not publish scheduled departure times before 6:45 a.m. (7:45 a.m. on Sundays) or after 9:45 p.m.
source_title: Orange County General Aviation Noise Ordinance (GANO), Sec. 2-1-30.4

description: FAA's 2019 capacity profile reports SFO capacity of 104-107 operations per hour in visual conditions, when arrivals use the closely spaced parallel runways 28L and 28R side by side, and 71-78 operations per hour in instrument conditions, when arrivals to the two runways are sequenced in trail.
source_title: FAA Airport Capacity Profile: San Francisco International Airport (2019)

description: An FAA order limits scheduled operations at Newark Liberty to 36 arrivals and 36 departures per hour (72 in total) from 6:00 a.m. through 10:59 p.m. Eastern, effective October 25, 2026 through October 30, 2027, to address air traffic controller staffing. EWR has been an FAA Level 2 schedule-facilitated airport since 2016.
source_title: Federal Register 2026-12589: Operating Limitations at Newark Liberty International Airport (published June 23 2026)

description: An FAA order limits scheduled U.S. and foreign air carrier arrivals and departures at JFK to 81 per hour from 6:00 a.m. through 10:59 p.m. Eastern. In June 2026 the FAA extended the order through October 28, 2028.
source_title: Federal Register 2026-12591: Operating Limitations at John F. Kennedy International Airport (published June 23 2026)

description: An FAA order makes 71 Operating Authorizations for scheduled operations available per hour at LaGuardia from 6:00 a.m. through 9:59 p.m. Eastern on Monday through Friday and from 12 noon through 9:59 p.m. on Sunday, plus 3 reservations per hour for unscheduled operations. In June 2026 the FAA extended the order through October 28, 2028.
source_title: Federal Register 2026-12592: Operating Limitations at New York LaGuardia Airport (published June 23 2026)

description: Port Authority airport rules allow nonstop domestic flights and pre-cleared international flights at LaGuardia only to and from points within 1,500 statute miles, plus Denver (perimeter rule). The limit does not apply on Saturdays or to general aviation operations at the Marine Air Terminal.
source_title: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey: Airport Rules and Regulations (revision dated April 1 2025)

description: Under the High Density Rule (14 CFR part 93, subparts K and S), regularly scheduled operations at Ronald Reagan Washington National are limited to 48 per hour from 6:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. Some additional operations are permitted by exemption on a limited basis under 49 U.S.C. 41714 and 41718.
source_title: FAA Slot Administration: U.S. Level 3 Airports

description: Federal regulation prohibits operating an aircraft nonstop in air transportation between Ronald Reagan Washington National and any airport more than 1,250 miles away (perimeter rule).
